extension.description: A local-first code pattern library with notes and optional BYOK AI.
command.key: Set or Clear AI API Key
view.name: Current File
config.database: SQLite database path. Reload the window to apply a path change. Existing data is not moved automatically.
config.enabled: Enable optional AI enhancements. All knowledge management features work without AI.
config.baseUrl: API base URL, with or without /v1. HTTPS or local HTTP endpoints only.
config.model: Your provider's model identifier. No model is selected automatically.
config.protocol: BYOK API protocol. Credentials are stored in VS Code SecretStorage.
